title: ‘The Riverbank,’ ‘Elza’ Top Rio Film Festival Awards as ‘On Behalf of My Son,’ ‘The French Teacher’ and ‘London’ Scoop Key Prizes
content:
Enock Carvalho and Matheus Farias’ Locarno-winning film shone brightly at Brazil's biggest film fest as summer/fall festival hits triumphed

ByRafa Sales Ross

Guest Contributor

Enock Carvalho and Matheus Farias’ Locarno-winning “The Riverbank” has taken Best Fiction Feature Film at this year’sRio Film Festival, with Eryk Rocha’s “Elza” scoring Best Documentary Feature Film. The awards were handed out tonight at an imposing ceremony at Rio de Janeiro’s legendary Odeon cinema.

“The Riverbank” is set in Recife and follows young cleaner Izaquiel (Caique Copque), whose nightly search for intimacy leads him to magnetic fisherman Jeremias (Ítalo Martins). As violence closes in, both embark on a journey into the depths of the mangroves, where reality and myth intertwine, exposing the invisible structures of power that govern their world. This is the duo’s directorial feature debut, and it comes a few months after Farias won a Platino Award for his editing of Kleber Mendonça Filho’s Oscar-nominated “The Secret Agent.”

“Elza” marks the follow-up to Rocha’s “The Falling Sky,” which premiered to great acclaim at Directors’ Fortnight. The film is a comprehensive documentary about one ofBrazil’s most renowned singers and public figures, Elza Soares. Drawing on rare archival materials and intimate conversations between Soares and the director during the final years of her life, “Elza” traces the icon’s seven-decade career while revealing the many facets of the woman behind the legend. The project comes with the backing of high-calibre partners, including Aruac Filmes (“Cinema Novo”), Maria Farinha Filmes (“The Beginning of Life”), Globo Filmes (“I’m Still Here”), RAI Cinema and Gullane+.

Other major Brazilian films of the year have also taken top awards, including Gabriel Martins’s Toronto-selected “On Behalf of My Son,” Venice-selected “London” by Victor di Marco and Márcio Picoli, and Ricardo Alves Jr.’s “The French Teacher,” which just bowed at San Sebastián.

This year’s Premiére Brasil jury was presided over by veteran “La Bola Negra” producer Esther García and also included co-director of programming at the Berlinale, Jacqueline Lyanga; French producer Sophie Erbs; composer Flavia Tygel; and casting director Marcela Altberg.

The New Trends jury was presided over by director and editor Karen Harley; screenwriter Maira Oliveira; producer Dora Amorim; director and screenwriter Guto Parente. The Felix Jury, dedicated to films broaching LGBTQIA+ issues, was presided over by lawyer Ericka Gavinho; director and screenwriter Clara Anastacia; cultural critic Guilherme Terri, also known as Rita Von Hunty; filmmaker Vita; and cultural programmer Rodrigo Gerace.

title_zh: 《河岸(The Riverbank)》和《艾爾莎(Elza)》在里約電影節上獲得最高榮譽，而《為我兒子而戰(On Behalf of My Son)》、《法國老師(The French Teacher)》和《倫敦(London)》則榮獲重要獎項。
content_zh:
恩諾克·卡瓦略(Enock Carvalho)和馬修斯·法里亞斯(Matheus Farias)的洛迦諾獲獎電影《河岸(The Riverbank)》在巴西最大的電影節上大放異彩，夏季/秋季影展的熱門作品也獲得了榮譽。

作者：拉法·薩萊斯·羅斯(Rafa Sales Ross)

特約撰稿人

恩諾克·卡瓦略(Enock Carvalho)和馬修斯·法里亞斯(Matheus Farias)的洛迦諾獲獎作品《河岸(The Riverbank)》在今年的里約電影節上獲得最佳劇情長片，艾瑞克·羅查(Eryk Rocha)的《艾爾莎(Elza)》則榮獲最佳紀錄片長片。頒獎典禮今晚在里約熱內盧的傳奇奧德昂影院舉行，場面壯觀。

《河岸(The Riverbank)》的故事設定在累西腓，講述了年輕清潔工伊薩基爾(Izaquiel)（蔡克·科普克(Caique Copque)）的故事，他在夜晚尋找親密關係的過程中遇見了迷人的漁夫耶雷米亞斯(Jeremias)（伊塔洛·馬丁斯(Ítalo Martins)）。隨著暴力的逼近，兩人踏上了深入紅樹林的旅程，現實與神話交織，揭示了統治他們世界的隱形權力結構。這是這對搭檔的導演長片首秀，距離法里亞斯(Matheus Farias)因剪輯克萊柏·門登卡·費利奧(Kleber Mendonça Filho)的奧斯卡提名作品《秘密特工(The Secret Agent)》而獲得的普拉蒂諾獎(Platino Award)僅幾個月。

《艾爾莎(Elza)》是羅查(Eryk Rocha)的《墜落的天空(The Falling Sky)》的後續作品，該片在導演雙周展映中獲得了極大的讚譽。這部電影是一部全面的紀錄片，講述了巴西最著名的歌手和公共人物之一艾爾莎·索阿雷斯(Elza Soares)的故事。影片利用珍貴的檔案材料和索阿雷斯(Soares)與導演在她生命最後幾年之間的親密對話，追溯這位偶像七十年的職業生涯，同時揭示這位傳奇背後的多面性。該項目得到了高水準合作夥伴的支持，包括阿魯阿克影業(Aruac Filmes)（《新電影(Cinema Novo)》）、瑪莉亞·法林哈影業(Maria Farinha Filmes)（《生命的開始(The Beginning of Life)》）、格洛博影業(Globo Filmes)（《我仍然在這裡(I’m Still Here)》）、意大利廣播電視(RAI Cinema)和古拉內+影業(Gullane+)。

其他一些主要的巴西電影也在今年獲得了重要獎項，包括加布里埃爾·馬丁斯(Gabriel Martins)的《為我的兒子而作(On Behalf of My Son)》、維克多·迪·馬爾科(Victor di Marco)和馬爾西奧·皮科利(Márcio Picoli)的《倫敦(London)》，以及里卡多·阿爾維斯·小(Ricardo Alves Jr.)的《法語老師(The French Teacher)》，該片剛在聖塞巴斯蒂安影展首映。

今年的Premiére Brasil評審團由資深製片人埃斯特·加西亞(Esther García)擔任主席，成員還包括柏林影展的聯合編程總監雅克琳·利安加(Jacqueline Lyanga)；法國製片人索菲·埃爾布(Sophie Erbs)；作曲家弗拉維亞·泰戈(Flavia Tygel)；以及選角導演馬塞拉·阿爾特貝格(Marcela Altberg)。

新趨勢評審團由導演兼剪輯師凱倫·哈利(Karen Harley)擔任主席；編劇瑪伊拉·奧利維拉(Maira Oliveira)；製片人多拉·阿莫林(Dora Amorim)；導演兼編劇古托·帕倫特(Guto Parente)擔任成員。專注於探討LGBTQIA+議題的費利克斯評審團由律師艾瑞卡·加維尼奧(Ericka Gavinho)擔任主席；導演兼編劇克拉拉·阿納斯塔西亞(Clara Anastacia)；文化評論家吉列爾梅·特里(Guilherme Terri)，也被稱為瑞塔·馮·亨提(Rita Von Hunty)；電影製作人維塔(Vita)；以及文化策劃人羅德里戈·赫拉斯(Rodrigo Gerace)擔任成員。
